Built-in protection for what you earn.

Common Questions

Questions before you get started.

Clear answers about how FireFaucet works, what it costs, and how you get paid.

View all FAQs →
How do I know FireFaucet is legitimate?
FireFaucet has been operating and paying users since 2018, with more than 1.2 million users joining the platform. Earnings come from tasks provided by established survey and offer partners, and you can withdraw them as crypto or gift cards.
Is FireFaucet free to use?
Yes. Creating an account and earning are free. Exchanging between balances is free too, and FireFaucet covers network and processing fees when you withdraw.
What are ACP, Activity Points, and Fuel?
ACP is what you earn and turn into a withdrawable balance. Activity Points raise your level and unlock better benefits, while Fuel powers Auto Faucet as it runs in the background.
Do I need to keep FireFaucet open?
No. Auto Faucet runs on FireFaucet's servers, not your device. You can close the page and it keeps converting ACP in the background until your ACP or Fuel runs out.
How do withdrawals work?
When a balance reaches the minimum for your chosen reward or network, you can withdraw or redeem it. Minimums vary, but FireFaucet covers withdrawal fees. You need a verified email, but there is no KYC or ID upload on our end.
Can I use FireFaucet in my country?
FireFaucet is open to users around the world, although available offers, gift cards, and cryptocurrencies can vary by region. Earning pages are unavailable while you are connected through a VPN or proxy.
